div.div: Main tables only. workspace_id also sits on claims, audience_runs, proof_reports and metric_series, and project_id on most project-scoped tables; those lines are not drawn. Composite foreign keys (for example campaign_id with project_id) keep a child row from pointing at another project. Authorization is enforced in the API, which connects as the table owner.
